create_prx_pipeline: create a PRX pipeline for text-to-image generation using Photoroom PRX transformer model
run_prx_text_to_image: run the PRX pipeline to generate images from text prompts with configurable resolution and guidance scale
encode_prx_prompt: encode text prompts into embeddings using the PRX text encoder with optional classifier-free guidance
clean_prx_text: clean and preprocess text prompts by removing URLs, special characters, and spam patterns
prepare_prx_latents: prepare initial noisy latents for the PRX diffusion process with specified dimensions and dtype
